title: 第四章 隐藏之门
content_zh:
“轰隆隆!”伴随着开门的震颤，李磊一行人也是顺利进入了古怪寺庙。

    令李磊一行人意外的是这寺庙貌似并没有机关陷阱。

    这个寺庙看起来小，没想到进入寺庙内部更是小的可怜，只有大厅和旁边一个卧室。只不过率先映入李磊他们眼帘的是供奉在大厅中间的雕像。

    别人家寺庙供奉着神仙，佛，菩萨，当然还有些人供奉土地就算是供奉当地大仙也是常见。但这个寺庙古怪就古怪在，这个寺庙竟然供奉的是魔!

    只见这雕像竟然栩栩如生，正直勾勾的盯着李磊等人，而这满天的邪气正是从这雕像散发的。

    李磊一行人更是被那凶恶的眼神盯出了一身冷汗。李磊他们也不敢轻举妄动，仿佛只要一动就要万劫不复。

    过了好一会李磊便鼓足勇气迈出了第一步，其他人见李磊动了，也开始小心翼翼的活动起来。

    “没什么好怕的只不过是一个雕像而已，又不能活过来把咱们吃了”李磊一边安慰众人一边擦拭额头上的汗水。

    不怕那是在说假话，怕!李磊能不怕吗，面对着这么恐怖的威势，就连李磊也是后背发寒，额头冷汗直流，这世间恐怕少有人见到这阵仗脸不红心不跳的。

    又过了一会李磊等人便逐渐适应了，对这寺庙探索起来，只不过他们依旧看向那雕像的眼神是躲闪的是恐惧的。

    当年十五万定永大军就是靠李磊众人盗墓寻宝所组建起来的，所以李磊一行人对秘地寻宝也是轻车熟路，不一会就发现了端倪。

    “这寺庙有东西!”李磊不一会发现了这寺庙的诡异。

    听李磊的话语其他人也是纷纷观察四周，想看看周围有没有什么线索，大厅由于那雕像的存在，他们便去卧室探索起来。

    于是他们便开始更加仔细的寻找，只不过还是一头雾水，只能隐隐约约感觉到那神秘的气息。

    李磊无意间扫了这寺庙周围的墙壁，这本来是无意之举没想到却给李磊带来了极大的惊喜。

    只见这寺庙的墙壁上竟刻画着古怪的纹路，这纹路不像是文字，更像是符咒!一条条符咒在墙壁交织起来竟然构成了一个大阵，这阵散发出的气息就是李磊等人苦苦寻找的气息。

    只不过这大阵甚是玄妙，竟然只有站在固定位置以固定的角度去看才能看出蹊跷，难怪李磊他们看不出来，这李磊可真是走了狗屎运了。

    李磊看着这大阵看了足足一个时辰还是无果，眼看马上想要放弃了，忽然李磊竟是眼前一亮，双手捏决对着那大阵一指。

    令人惊奇的一幕发生了，只见那面刻着大阵的墙忽然分崩瓦解，一道闪着奇异光华的门在李磊面前浮现。

    其他人听见声响便纷纷赶过来，看到这一幕也是吃了一惊。虽然他们对此很是吃惊，但是看向李磊的目光更是投来无数小星星，那种目光都是崇拜的目光。

    从这就看出李磊之前定永军为什么那么壮大了，虽然坑蒙拐骗，金钱诱惑可能占了那么一丢丢，但是定永军的将士多半是被李磊的人格魅力所折服的。

    虽然这门已经在李磊等人的面前了但李磊身边的人还是面对这门里散发出未知的气息感到紧张。

    但李磊却是不同，因为他信奉一句话，机遇往往伴随着危险，而危险往往伴随着机遇。

    于是李磊想都没想便走了进去。
content_en:
"Boom!" With the trembling of the door opening, Li Lei and his group successfully entered the weird temple.

    What surprised Li Lei and his party was that there seemed to be no traps in the temple.

    This temple looks small, but I didn't expect it to be even smaller inside. There is only a hall and a bedroom next to it. But the first thing that caught Li Lei's eyes was the statue enshrined in the middle of the hall.

    Other people's temples enshrine gods, Buddhas, and Bodhisattvas. Of course, it is common for some people to enshrine land even to local immortals. But the weird thing about this temple is that it actually worships demons!

    I saw that this statue was lifelike, staring directly at Li Lei and others, and the evil spirit in the sky was emanating from this statue.

    Li Lei and his group were even covered in cold sweat by the ferocious eyes. Li Lei and the others did not dare to act rashly, as if they would be doomed if they moved.

    After a while, Li Lei mustered up the courage to take the first step. Seeing Li Lei move, the others also began to move cautiously.

    "There's nothing to be afraid of. It's just a statue. It can't come alive and eat us." Li Lei comforted everyone while wiping the sweat from his forehead.

    I'm not afraid that I'm telling lies, I'm afraid! How can Li Lei not be afraid? Faced with such a terrifying power, even Li Lei felt chills on his back and cold sweat on his forehead. I'm afraid there are few people in the world who can't see this battle without blushing or heart beating.

    After a while, Li Lei and others gradually adapted and began to explore the temple, but they still looked at the statue with evasive and fearful eyes.

    At that time, the 150,000 Dingyong army was formed by Li Lei and his men robbing tombs and hunting for treasures. Therefore, Li Lei and his party were also familiar with treasure hunting in secret places, and they discovered the clues after a while.

    "There is something in this temple!" Li Lei soon discovered the strangeness of this temple.

    After listening to Li Lei's words, the others also looked around to see if there were any clues. Due to the presence of the statue in the hall, they went to the bedroom to explore.

    So they began to search more carefully, but they were still confused and could only vaguely feel the mysterious aura.

    Li Lei accidentally scanned the walls around the temple. This was an unintentional move, but it brought Li Lei a huge surprise.

    I saw strange patterns carved on the walls of this temple. The patterns were not like words, but more like spells! The spells were intertwined on the wall to form a large array. The aura emitted by this array was the aura Li Lei and others were looking for.

    It's just that this formation is very mysterious. You can only see the strangeness if you stand in a fixed position and look at it from a fixed angle. No wonder Li Lei and the others can't see it. This Li Lei is really lucky.

    Li Lei looked at the formation for a full hour with no results, and he was about to give up. Suddenly, Li Lei's eyes lit up, and he pointed at the formation with both hands.

    A surprising scene happened. The wall with the large formation suddenly disintegrated, and a door shining with strange brilliance appeared in front of Li Lei.

    Others rushed over when they heard the noise and were surprised to see this scene. Although they were very surprised by this, their eyes were filled with countless little stars when they looked at Li Lei. Those eyes were full of admiration.

    From this we can see why the Dingyong Army was so strong before Li Lei. Although cheating and money temptation may have played a small role, most of the officers and soldiers of the Dingyong Army were impressed by Li Lei's personality charm.

    Although the door was already in front of Li Lei and others, the people around Li Lei still felt nervous facing the unknown aura emanating from the door.

    But Li Lei is different, because he believes in a saying that opportunities are often accompanied by dangers, and dangers are often accompanied by opportunities.

    So Li Lei walked in without thinking.
